name: AI Governance Analyst
description: Owns AI governance controls across the Data & AI value stream, assessing generative AI use cases against policy guardrails and managing AI incidents. Maintains the AI policy framework, conducts algorithmic fairness testing and model explainability reviews, and prepares AI regulatory reporting and consumer disclosures with legal and compliance through the GRC platform.

name: AIOps Engineer
description: Leads ML-driven IT operations across the Data & AI value stream, building event correlation, anomaly detection, and auto-remediation capabilities. Engineers time-series features from telemetry, calibrates detection thresholds to suppress false positives, binds runbooks to enriched alerts, and documents remediation-action controls to keep AIOps model governance auditable.

name: ALM / Asset-Liability Actuary
description: Owns asset-liability analysis within the Actuarial value stream, constructing risk correlation matrices and incorporating stress outcomes into ORSA and ICAAP. Monitors reserve development and prior-year movements, updates ceded loss estimates each reserve cycle, supports board actuarial reporting and the statutory actuarial opinion, and archives assumptions on actuarial modeling platforms.

name: AML Analyst
description: Performs anti-money-laundering compliance within the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, investigating alerts and recommending SAR filing or case closure. Conducts enterprise-wide AML risk assessments, calibrates transaction monitoring rules, performs enhanced due diligence on high-risk customers, and prepares regulatory filings and examination response packages under the AML programme governance framework.

name: API Developer
description: Builds and operates integrations across the Technology & Engineering value stream, deploying to test environments and executing end-to-end validation. Manages the event streaming platform and API gateway, governs API design standards through stakeholder reviews, maintains partner connectivity, and monitors API adoption with feedback from consumer teams.

name: Access Management Analyst
description: Administers identity and access services within the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream, covering directory services, single sign-on, and multi-factor authentication. Onboards applications to the SSO platform, manages federation trusts, runs risk-tiered access certification campaigns and archives their evidence, and hardens directory configurations to baseline on the IAM platform.

name: Account Executive
description: Manages broker distribution relationships across the Sales, Distribution & Marketing value stream, supporting renewal retention and distribution sales operations. Verifies producer license status, maintains producer compliance records, and governs producer terminations, while allocating quotas, analyzing forecast-to-actual variances, and securing compliance sign-off on partner materials in the CRM.

name: Accountant
description: Performs accounting operations spanning the Finance & Investments value stream with additional work in Reinsurance and Actuarial. Prepares GAAP financial reporting, processes accounts payable disbursements and reinsurance accounting, supports rolling forecasts and financial examinations, and handles capital instruments and M&A financial support, clearing unreconciled cash breaks in the general ledger.

name: Accounts Payable Specialist
description: Processes payables and cost accounting within the Finance & Investments value stream, with supporting work in Actuarial and Claims. Reconciles ALAE actuals against accruals, produces final cost reconciliation reports, posts recovery receipts to the claims ledger, and prepares statutory reserve schedules supporting financial statement preparation and examinations in the ERP.

name: Accounts Receivable Analyst
description: Owns premium receivable accounting within the Finance & Investments value stream, generating invoices and processing lockbox and ACH payment receipts. Reconciles billing to ledger and broker statements-of-account, monitors delinquency with dunning notices and payment arrangements, clears unapplied cash from suspense, and books allowances and write-offs on the billing platform.

name: Actuarial Analyst
description: Performs actuarial analysis across the Actuarial value stream with support to Product & Delivery, maintaining data quality and validating exposure data. Runs regulatory and internal economic capital computations, defines stress scenario sets, calculates indicated rate changes with documented rate indication memoranda, and contributes to actuarial financial and board reporting on modeling platforms.

name: Actuary
description: Leads core actuarial work within the Actuarial value stream, constructing triangles, screening data anomalies, and performing reserve adequacy testing. Calibrates risk module parameters for internal economic capital models and regulatory capital computation, defines stress scenarios including terror and cyber, and supports actuarial financial reporting, planning, and board reporting.

name: Affinity & Embedded Insurance Manager
description: Manages affinity and embedded distribution partnerships within the Sales, Distribution & Marketing value stream, governing agency and broker relationships and delegated authority oversight. Builds target prospect lists from white-space analysis, maintains pipeline forecasts and logs bound submissions in the CRM, tracks corrective actions, and secures compliance sign-off on partner materials.
